name: FeedNest
tagline: The news reader your AI can read. Articles, highlights, notes, tags, and audio.
description:
FeedNest is a news reader for the websites, blogs, podcasts and YouTube channels you choose. Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants can read it too, so you can ask them what's new in your sources.

The OpenClaw plugin gives AI agents direct access to your articles, highlights, notes, and tags through natural language. 26 tools covering articles, feeds, folders, tags, highlights, notes, saving, and text-to-speech.

Read-only tools enabled by default. Write and AI tools require explicit allowlisting.
